question: What configuration of head and face characterizes Maheśa in the Rudra form?
premises: The context concerns Maheśa in the Rudra form.
The head and face are specified as singular.
inference: In the Rudra form, Maheśa is to be conceived with only one head and one face.
plain_english: In the Rudra form of Maheśa, there is only one head and one face.
